name: images
description: An IMAGES band above the prompt with a tile per [Image #n] tag in the prompt box, the tag and the tile's size beneath; tiles leave when the tag leaves the box. The engine does not hand a plugin a pasted image's bytes before the prompt is sent, so each tile is a placeholder (no preview). /images on | off.

size.title: Tile height in rows
size.description: 16, 24 (default) or 32 terminal rows; a tile is twice as many columns wide (48 by 24 at the default). Shrunk to fit the band's height and width.
